purpose: Test whether a frozen source/reference SAM completion converts the official scribble into a substantially stronger unary before exact primitive adjoint and the current fixed support operator.
claim_name: LUDVIG-role-compatible source-reference completion with official SAM3
claim_exclusions: not the LUDVIG released all-view protocol
not eligible to relabel the reproduced LUDVIG 0.9125768502741802 result as strict unseen
not an intrinsic compact-field-only result because an external 2D decoder completes the source mask

reference_preprocessing.decode: PIL Image.open followed by convert RGB
reference_preprocessing.resize: PIL LANCZOS directly from the frozen source RGB to width 1008 and height 756
reference_preprocessing.reason: The exact responsibility and official scribble authority are both native 1008x756.
receipt_requirements: bind source RGB path, bytes, and sha256
bind positive and negative scribble paths, nonzero pixel counts, and sha256
bind official SAM3 source commit, checkpoint sha256, config sha256, torch version, dtype, and device

positive_prompt_sampling.relationship_to_ludvig: Mirror LUDVIG sam_predict multiplicities: thirty positive pixels are sampled once and reshaped into ten triplets; no negative points are sent to SAM.
positive_prompt_sampling.population: all nonzero pixels of the official positive scribble in row-major pixel-id order
positive_prompt_sampling.coordinate_format: float32 (x,y) pixel-index coordinates, matching the official predict_inst point interface and LUDVIG's integer pixel-coordinate convention
positive_prompt_sampling.deterministic_rank: rank the population by SplitMix64(pixel_id XOR 0x243F6A8885A308D3), with pixel_id ascending as an exact tie break; take the first 30 and reshape contiguously to [10,3,2]
positive_prompt_sampling.splitmix64: z=(x+0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) mod 2^64; z=(z xor (z>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9 mod 2^64; z=(z xor (z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB mod 2^64; return z xor (z>>31)

reference_mask_completion.per_call_validation: require exactly one HxW mask and one finite quality value; reject malformed or nonfinite output
reference_mask_completion.aggregation: arithmetic mean of ten binary official SAM3 masks
reference_mask_completion.threshold: skimage.filters.threshold_li on the 1008x756 aggregate; completed positive is aggregate greater than or equal to the returned threshold
reference_mask_completion.scribble_authority: overwrite raw positive pixels true, then overwrite raw negative pixels false
reference_mask_completion.negative_observation: retain the raw negative scribble as the explicit negative channel; do not treat every pixel outside the completed positive mask as negative
frozen_artifacts: positive and negative observation tensor bundle
JSON receipt containing all input, output, implementation, and environment hashes

exact_adjoint.operator: exact sparse front-to-back W transpose divided by W transpose one at 1008x756
exact_adjoint.negative_observation: the frozen raw negative scribble mask
exact_adjoint.signed_evidence: (positive_mass - negative_mass) divided by visible_mass where visible_mass is positive
exact_adjoint.overlap_policy: raw negative overwrite in the reference mask makes the two pixel observations exclusive before adjoint

current_fixed_support.relation: query-independent official C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive signed multiplicative hash256 diagnostic reconstructed from the compact canonical field
current_fixed_support.classifier: sklearn balanced LogisticRegression C=0.01 on nonzero signed evidence, sample weighted by evidence_weight

two_phase_freeze_and_score.phase_1: Generate and hash both source completions in order horns_left then fern without opening either target RGB, target mask, or target metric.
two_phase_freeze_and_score.phase_2: Generate and hash both exact-adjoint/current-support primitive artifacts without opening either target RGB, target mask, or target metric.
two_phase_freeze_and_score.phase_3: Only after both phase-2 receipts exist, reload frozen primitive artifacts and call the frozen target scorer in order horns_left then fern.

sentinel_plan.device: GPU0 only after explicit scheduler notification; GPU1 remains reserved for Field-A
sentinel_plan.launch_status: blocked until the official SAM3 CUDA preflight succeeds
sentinel_plan.estimated_serial_wall_clock: 7-13 minutes for both sentinels after the runtime is compatible
sentinel_plan.full8: not authorized by this registration; requires a separate result gate and registration

comparison_boundary.ludvig_protocol: released all-view, original 3DGS geometry, SAM v1 ViT-H, every registered view RGB visible during uplift, three seeds
comparison_boundary.this_protocol: single source/reference RGB only, official SAM3, exact source adjoint, current compact capability/support, deterministic one-run sentinel
comparison_boundary.interpretation: The sentinel isolates whether stronger source unary completion repairs the query-interface bottleneck; it does not close the field/protocol gap to LUDVIG by construction.

safety.thermal_policy_when_later_authorized: single GPU0 job, ordinary telemetry only, no frequent stop-trigger loop
